Once the fuel analysis is accepted, we'll explain how its component loads and
matched woody contrast were derived, modeled, and summarized. The planned

calculation needed to interpret the caption and Results consistently. Detailed
diagnostics and decisions remain in [F01](task-f01.qmd),
[RD04](task-rd04.qmd#rd04-inference-review), and the supplement, while M03 will
adapt those records into manuscript wording with the design's causal limits clear.
